blocks.raw: <ExamTip>Temporary/Special Permits are: (1) issued only to individuals from countries with reciprocity; (2) valid only for ONE project; (3) cannot be extended or renewed — a new application is required for subsequent projects; and (4) the permit holder must work under a Filipino counterpart who assumes full professional responsibility.</ExamTip>

blocks.raw: <Tip>Permanent licensing of foreign architects is NOT permitted under RA 9266. Foreigners may only practice through temporary/special permits. Foreign architects cannot sign and seal architectural documents independently — the Filipino counterpart must authenticate all work.</Tip>
